title: Run frozen checks in the workspace mask
body:
Evaluation harness slice (decision .krn/runs/claude/eval-design/decision.md): krn eval check runs a task check inside krn eval mask without network, executes npm run scripts from frozen base expansions in the manifest, and treats zero executed tests as FAIL.
Acceptance: a candidate that rewrites a script to true, a test-name pattern matching nothing, and a check that times out all yield FAIL through the real CLI; a passing frozen test check yields PASS with counts.
Paused (operator 2026-10-27) until the FR-40 power check; the implementation waits on branch feat/eval-checks.
